source: get_metric_visualizations of aisc-plugin-data-evaluation 0.4.1 and aisc-plugin-langbite 0.2.6, 2026-10-05 (no time windows)

visualizations.title: PSI per feature
visualizations.description: Population stability index of each numeric feature (score: PSI / 0.25, capped at 1).

visualizations.title: Drift tests per feature
visualizations.description: Each test's score per feature; the raw statistic, p-value and flag are in the measures' dimensions.

visualizations.title: Pass rate per concern

visualizations.title: Failed cases
visualizations.description: Every answer of every failed case: the prompt as sent, the target's answer, and what the test expected.
